title: Current behavior and compatibility notes
summary: Check the current implementation boundaries and differences between historical examples and supported behavior.

blocks.text: This page records concrete differences between current implementation and older notes or comments. They are documentation findings; the engine code is not changed by this documentation update.

cells: Receives time, dt, context. A single dt-like name still receives absolute time.
Pass alpha separately; Color.fromHex handles 4/8-digit RGBA strings.
Public option/property is strokeWidth. setClip takes Vec2 spatial clipping bounds.
Use model/CameraModel. fov is consumed as radians despite the literal constructor default 45.
FISHEYE and VR360 fall back in getProjectionMatrix; enum presence is not full raster support.
Immediate framing; no frameAnimated method in the current class.
add(...animations) advances a relative playhead; no timestamp argument.
animateValue is the public scalar animation helper; no animate.setValue method.
getTangentLine(x, graph, options); Riemann x range/dx are separate arguments.
Exported name is RaymarchedPlot3D; filename remains RaymarchPlot3D.ts.
Also applies a projected depth bias; large values can clip geometry.
Cache key distinguishes charset length, not charset contents or textureSize.
Selects the first target per symbol; multiple stored targets do not implement NFA execution.
Renderer/pass combinations matter; analytical path content and fast mega batches require visual verification.
Set material fields after construction; the forwarded material getter needs the child volume to exist.
Function returns Vec3 and constructor uses options, not range tuples.
addNode(id, options), not an object containing id.
Construct with Scene; add(entity, options); motion uses static/dynamic/kinematic.
Jolt source exists but controller/barrel do not route/export it; addSoftBody rejects unsupported backends.
2D uses one fixed step per scene update; 3D scales scene.dt again by timeScale.
Reuses compatible GPU resources but factories still allocate JavaScript objects.
Current font generation/resolution is in-browser; no server/msdf-server.ts or msdf-server npm script.
Use Scene.audio instance methods such as playBGM, not an AudioManager.playMusic static facade.
PNG viewport screenshots after wall-clock delays; seconds for --times, no --format option. These are approximate preview captures rather than deterministic offline keyframes.
Serves the calling project’s index.html; the host must load the scene selected by ?file=. Duration is milliseconds; --out selects a directory, no implemented -b flag.
The completed scene bundle runs independently; this checkout’s export entry and aliases still expect a repository src/engine layout. External npm export needs a package-based entry.
Puppeteer/ws/cli-progress imports exceed what the root manifest explicitly declares.
Pooling and batching reduce cost; historical benchmark figures do not establish universal zero-GC or FPS guarantees.
